ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The image is a regional map of the North Atlantic, in which Europe, the northwestern part of Africa, and the North Atlantic sea area can be seen. Arrows in the figure indicate the connection of ocean currents between the low-latitude North Atlantic and the high-latitude sea areas near Europe and Greenland, and there are arrows returning southward, showing that the surface ocean currents and the bottom return flow together constitute the North Atlantic overturning circulation. Then reason: Global climate warming will cause glaciers and ice sheets in polar regions, especially near Greenland and the Arctic Ocean, to melt, and a large amount of freshwater will enter the surface layer of the North Atlantic, diluting the surface seawater and reducing the salinity of the seawater; the decrease in salinity will cause the density of surface seawater to decrease, making it difficult to sink in high-latitude sea areas to form deep water, so the ocean current system of the surface flowing northward and the bottom returning southward will be blocked.

raw_record.original_question:
<image1>
全球气候变暖将导致北大西洋表层和底层的洋流系统阻断，其主要原因是什么？
raw_record.answer: Global warming, polar glacier melting, surface seawater salinity decreases, density decreases
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: The image is a regional map of the North Atlantic, in which Europe, the northwestern part of Africa, and the North Atlantic sea area can be seen. Arrows in the figure indicate the connection of ocean currents between the low-latitude North Atlantic and the high-latitude sea areas near Europe and Greenland, and there are arrows returning southward, showing that the surface ocean currents and the bottom return flow together constitute the North Atlantic overturning circulation. Then reason: Global climate warming will cause glaciers and ice sheets in polar regions, especially near Greenland and the Arctic Ocean, to melt, and a large amount of freshwater will enter the surface layer of the North Atlantic, diluting the surface seawater and reducing the salinity of the seawater; the decrease in salinity will cause the density of surface seawater to decrease, making it difficult to sink in high-latitude sea areas to form deep water, so the ocean current system of the surface flowing northward and the bottom returning southward will be blocked.
